Worship Allah alone and do good to parents, relatives, orphans, the needy, neighbors, companions, travelers and those your right hands possess; Allah dislikes the self-deluding and boastful.
Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten like it, and whoever comes with an evil deed is recompensed only its like, and none will be wronged.
Whoever does righteousness, male or female, while a believer will be given a good life and rewarded for the best of what they did.
Whoever does righteous deeds as a believer will not have his effort denied, for Allah records it.
Allah's term is coming for whoever hopes to meet Him; striving benefits only the striver, and believers doing righteous deeds have misdeeds removed and are rewarded by their best deeds.
All honor belongs to Allah; good speech rises to Him, raised by righteous work, while those who plot evil face severe punishment and their plotting will perish.
None speaks better than one who invites to Allah and does righteousness; good and evil are not equal, so repel evil with what is better, granted only to the patient.
Whoever does good does it for himself, whoever does evil does it against himself, and Allah is never unjust to His servants.
Allah repays evildoers for their deeds and rewards those who do good, who avoid major sins and immoralities, with the best; He is vast in forgiveness, so claim no purity.
The difficult pass is freeing a slave or feeding an orphaned relative or a needy person on a day of hunger, then being among believers who urge patience and compassion.
